scenarios.name: transaction_collision
scenarios.injected_condition: Two simultaneous transactions targeting the exact same victim IP
scenarios.expected_behavior: Target lock serializes requests cleanly without state collision

scenarios.name: shared_state_lock_contention
scenarios.injected_condition: Multi-threaded target lock contention under high load
scenarios.expected_behavior: Contention is tracked with accurate wait durations; state integrity preserved

scenarios.name: duplicate_transaction
scenarios.injected_condition: Duplicate transaction issued while active transaction exists on target
scenarios.expected_behavior: Duplicate transaction rejected safely with ABORTED state
scenarios.actual_behavior: State=ABORTED, Msg=Duplicate transaction rejected: active transaction TX-0181 in progress for 10.200.1.5

scenarios.name: stale_snapshot
scenarios.injected_condition: Target state altered between snapshot and mutation apply
scenarios.expected_behavior: Stale snapshot detected, transaction aborted before applying unverified mutation
scenarios.actual_behavior: State=ABORTED, Msg=Stale snapshot detected: target state was modified before mutation

scenarios.name: rollback_while_another_transaction_is_active
scenarios.injected_condition: Rollback executed on Target A while Target B remains mutated and active
scenarios.expected_behavior: Target A restored without impacting Target B active enforcement

scenarios.name: watchdog_expiry_during_concurrent_transaction
scenarios.injected_condition: Watchdog TTL expires on Target 1 while Target 2 is still valid
scenarios.expected_behavior: Expired transaction automatically rolled back; active transaction preserved

scenarios.name: victim_namespace_disappearance
scenarios.injected_condition: Target namespace validation failure (simulated netns deletion)
scenarios.expected_behavior: Fails closed, aborting transaction before any command execution
scenarios.actual_behavior: State=ABORTED, Msg=Snapshot creation failed: Target validation failed: Fault injection: target validation forced failure

scenarios.name: actuator_backend_failure
scenarios.expected_behavior: Automatic compensation rollback triggered; clean baseline verified

scenarios.name: post_verification_mismatch
scenarios.injected_condition: verify_mutation returns False after actuator returns success
scenarios.expected_behavior: Automatic rollback engages immediately; transaction marked ROLLED_BACK

scenarios.name: audit_persistence_failure
scenarios.injected_condition: Audit record write failure occurs prior to final transaction commit
scenarios.expected_behavior: Fails closed with automatic rollback; mutation not left unmonitored

scenarios.name: authorization_expiry
scenarios.expected_behavior: Transaction rejected with SAFETY_LOCKED state; zero mutation executed
scenarios.actual_behavior: State=SAFETY_LOCKED, Msg=Enforcement rejected: PreconditionGate is not in READY state (enforcement strictly locked)

scenarios.name: safety_gate_failure
scenarios.injected_condition: DeterministicSafetyGate raises exception during prepare stage
scenarios.expected_behavior: Transaction aborted safely; no mutation attempted
scenarios.actual_behavior: State=ABORTED, Msg=Safety gate evaluation failure (injected fault)
